scripts.dev: node server/index.mjs & API_PID=$!; trap 'kill $API_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT; vp dev --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.test: vp run test:unit && vp run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: node --test server/domain.test.mjs server/domain-property.test.mjs server/engine-simulation.test.mjs shared/time.test.mjs && vp test run src/calendar.test.ts
scripts.smoke:preview: vp run build && PLAYWRIGHT_PREVIEW=true playwright test --grep @smoke
